text: FOL ::: ∀x (Employee(x) ∧ EligibleForPromotion(x) → ((WorkedAtCompanyForAtLeastTwoYears(x) ∧ GoodPerformanceRecord(x)) ∨ RecommendationFromSupervisor(x))) ::: To be eligible for a promotion, an employee must have worked at the company for at least two years and have a good performance record, unless they have a recommendation from a supervisor.
